options.B: Just before substantial completion; it becomes the basis of the contractor's final punch list.
options.C: Right after the correction period ends; it replaces the later facility condition assessments.
options.D: About two years after occupancy; it is used mainly to settle claims with the contractor.
options.E: About one year after occupancy; it starts the facility condition assessment cycle.
options.F: About three to six months after occupancy; it replaces the routine maintenance records.

questions.explanation: A post-occupancy evaluation works best about three to six months after the building is first occupied, and it then serves as the baseline for the ongoing facility evaluation program. At that point it can still catch nonconforming work and warranty items missed before occupancy, which waiting until the correction period ends would lose. It does not replace later condition assessments or the maintenance records.

Site Improvements is a level 2 title inside it (32 30 00), and Exterior Specialties is a level 2 title in Division 10 (10 70 00).

Division 10 is Specialties, which only has a level 2 group named Exterior Specialties (10 70 00), and Division 34 is Transportation.

Water Utilities is a level 2 title inside it (33 10 00), and Plumbing is Division 22, which covers piping within the facility.

questions.explanation: Utilities is Division 33 (33 00 00), in the Site and Infrastructure Subgroup after Exterior Improvements (32) and before Transportation (34). questions.question: In MasterFormat, what is the title of Division 34 (34 00 00)?

questions.explanation: Division 34 is Transportation, in the Site and Infrastructure Subgroup between Utilities (33) and Waterway and Marine Construction (35). questions.explanation: Transportation is Division 34 (34 00 00), in the Site and Infrastructure Subgroup after Utilities (33) and before Waterway and Marine Construction (35). questions.explanation: Division 35 is Waterway and Marine Construction, the last titled division of the Site and Infrastructure Subgroup; Divisions 36 through 39 are reserved. Coastal Construction (35 30 00) and Waterway Construction and Equipment (35 40 00) are level 2 titles inside it, not the division title, and Water and Wastewater Equipment is Division 46, in the Process Equipment Subgroup.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, which division number is titled Waterway and Marine Construction?

questions.explanation: Waterway and Marine Construction is Division 35 (35 00 00), the last titled division of the Site and Infrastructure Subgroup, after Transportation (34). It covers coastal, waterway, marine and dam construction. Divisions 36 through 39 are reserved, and Division 46, Water and Wastewater Equipment, is treatment equipment in the Process Equipment Subgroup.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, which statements about the Process Equipment divisions are correct?

options.A: Division 40 is titled Process Interconnections.

options.C: Division 47 is titled Electrical Power Generation.
options.D: Division 43 is titled Pollution and Waste Control Equipment.
options.E: Both {A} and {B}
options.F: Both {B} and {D}

questions.explanation: In the Process Equipment Subgroup, Division 40 is Process Interconnections and Division 41 is Material Processing and Handling Equipment, so {E} is right. Electrical Power Generation is Division 48, while 47 is reserved, and Pollution and Waste Control Equipment is Division 44; Division 43 covers the handling, purification and storage of process gases and liquids.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, which division number is titled Process Interconnections?

options.A: Division 41 (41 00 00)
options.B: Division 43 (43 00 00)
options.C: Division 42 (42 00 00)
options.D: Division 40 (40 00 00)
options.E: Division 44 (44 00 00)
options.F: Division 46 (46 00 00)

questions.explanation: Process Interconnections is Division 40 (40 00 00), the first division of the Process Equipment Subgroup. It holds the process piping, ductwork, chutes, instrumentation and controls that connect process equipment. Division 41 is Material Processing and Handling Equipment, Division 42 covers process heating, cooling and drying, and Division 43 covers process gas and liquid handling.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, what is the title of Division 41 (41 00 00)?

options.A: Process Interconnections
options.B: Material Processing and Handling Equipment
options.C: Process Gas and Liquid Handling, Purification, and Storage Equipment
options.D: Process Heating, Cooling, and Drying Equipment
options.E: Conveying Equipment
options.F: Piece Material Handling Equipment

questions.explanation: Division 41 is Material Processing and Handling Equipment, in the Process Equipment Subgroup between Process Interconnections (40) and Division 42 (process heating, cooling and drying). It covers bulk material processing, piece material handling, manufacturing equipment, packaging and material storage. Piece Material Handling Equipment is a level 2 title inside it (41 20 00), and Conveying Equipment for buildings is Division 14.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, which division number is titled Material Processing and Handling Equipment?

options.A: Division 41 (41 00 00)
options.B: Division 40 (40 00 00)
options.C: Division 42 (42 00 00)
options.D: Division 43 (43 00 00)
options.E: Division 14 (14 00 00)
options.F: Division 45 (45 00 00)

questions.explanation: Material Processing and Handling Equipment is Division 41 (41 00 00), in the Process Equipment Subgroup right after Process Interconnections (40). It holds bulk material processing, piece material handling such as conveyors, cranes and hoists, manufacturing equipment and material storage. Division 14, Conveying Equipment, covers elevators, escalators and lifts for buildings.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, what is the title of Division 42 (42 00 00)?

options.A: Process Gas and Liquid Handling, Purification, and Storage Equipment
options.B: Material Processing and Handling Equipment
options.C: Process Heating, Cooling, and Drying Equipment
options.D: Process Interconnections
options.E: Heating, Ventilating, and Air Conditioning (HVAC)
options.F: Process Heating Equipment

questions.explanation: Division 42 is Process Heating, Cooling, and Drying Equipment, in the Process Equipment Subgroup between Division 41 (material processing and handling) and Division 43 (process gas and liquid handling). Process Heating Equipment is only one of its three level 2 titles (42 10 00), next to process cooling and process drying equipment. Heating, ventilating and air conditioning for the building is Division 23.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, which division number is titled Process Heating, Cooling, and Drying Equipment?

options.A: Division 41 (41 00 00)
options.B: Division 40 (40 00 00)
options.C: Division 42 (42 00 00)
options.D: Division 43 (43 00 00)
options.E: Division 23 (23 00 00)
options.F: Division 44 (44 00 00)

questions.explanation: Process Heating, Cooling, and Drying Equipment is Division 42 (42 00 00), in the Process Equipment Subgroup after Division 41 (material processing and handling) and before Division 43 (process gas and liquid handling). It covers heating, cooling and drying equipment for industrial processes. Building heating and cooling is HVAC, Division 23, in the Facility Services Subgroup.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, what is the title of Division 43 (43 00 00)?

options.A: Pollution and Waste Control Equipment
options.B: Material Processing and Handling Equipment

options.D: Process Heating, Cooling, and Drying Equipment

options.F: Water and Wastewater Equipment

questions.explanation: Division 43 is titled Process Gas and Liquid Handling, Purification, and Storage Equipment; it sits in the Process Equipment Subgroup between Division 42 (process heating, cooling and drying) and Division 44 (pollution and waste control). Gas and Liquid Purification Equipment is only one level 2 title inside it (43 30 00), and Water and Wastewater Equipment is Division 46.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, which division number is titled Process Gas and Liquid Handling, Purification, and Storage Equipment?

options.A: Division 42 (42 00 00)
options.B: Division 44 (44 00 00)
options.C: Division 41 (41 00 00)
options.D: Division 43 (43 00 00)
options.E: Division 46 (46 00 00)

questions.explanation: The title Process Gas and Liquid Handling, Purification, and Storage Equipment belongs to Division 43 (43 00 00), in the Process Equipment Subgroup. It covers equipment for handling, purifying and storing process gases and liquids. Division 42 is process heating, cooling and drying, Division 44 is pollution and waste control, and Division 46 is water and wastewater equipment.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, what is the title of Division 44 (44 00 00)?

options.A: Industry-Specific Manufacturing Equipment
options.B: Process Heating, Cooling, and Drying Equipment
options.C: Pollution and Waste Control Equipment
options.D: Process Gas and Liquid Handling, Purification, and Storage Equipment

options.F: Water and Wastewater Equipment

questions.explanation: Division 44 is Pollution and Waste Control Equipment, in the Process Equipment Subgroup between Division 43 (process gas and liquid handling) and Division 45 (industry-specific manufacturing). It covers air, noise, odor and water pollution control and solid waste control. Water Pollution Control Equipment is a level 2 title inside it (44 40 00), and Water and Wastewater Equipment is Division 46.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, which division number is titled Pollution and Waste Control Equipment?

questions.explanation: Pollution and Waste Control Equipment is Division 44 (44 00 00), in the Process Equipment Subgroup after Division 43 and before Industry-Specific Manufacturing Equipment (45). It holds air, noise, odor and water pollution control and solid waste equipment. Water and Wastewater Equipment is Division 46, and Division 47 is reserved with no title.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, what is the title of Division 45 (45 00 00)?

options.A: Industry-Specific Manufacturing Equipment

options.C: Pollution and Waste Control Equipment
options.D: Process Gas and Liquid Handling, Purification, and Storage Equipment
options.E: Manufacturing Equipment
options.F: Material Processing and Handling Equipment

questions.explanation: Division 45 is Industry-Specific Manufacturing Equipment, in the Process Equipment Subgroup between Pollution and Waste Control Equipment (44) and Water and Wastewater Equipment (46). Its level 2 numbers are left for users to define by industry, such as textiles or fabricated metal products. Manufacturing Equipment is a level 2 title in Division 41 (41 30 00), not a division title.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, which division number is titled Industry-Specific Manufacturing Equipment?

options.A: Division 44 (44 00 00)

questions.explanation: Industry-Specific Manufacturing Equipment is Division 45 (45 00 00), in the Process Equipment Subgroup after Pollution and Waste Control Equipment (44) and before Water and Wastewater Equipment (46). Its level 2 numbers are left for users to define by industry. General manufacturing equipment appears instead as a level 2 group within Division 41, and Division 47 is reserved.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, what is the title of Division 46 (46 00 00)?

options.A: Electrical Power Generation

questions.explanation: Division 46 is Water and Wastewater Equipment, in the Process Equipment Subgroup after Industry-Specific Manufacturing Equipment (45); Division 47 is reserved. It covers treatment equipment from preliminary treatment and chemical feed through clarification, advanced treatment and residuals handling. Water Pollution Control Equipment is a level 2 title in Division 44 (44 40 00), and site water and sewer lines are Utilities, Division 33.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, which division number is titled Water and Wastewater Equipment?

questions.explanation: Water and Wastewater Equipment is Division 46 (46 00 00), in the Process Equipment Subgroup after Division 45 and before the reserved Division 47. It holds water and wastewater treatment equipment, from chemical feed to residuals handling. Utilities, Division 33, covers the site water and sewer piping, and Electrical Power Generation is Division 48.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, what is the title of Division 48 (48 00 00)?

options.A: Electrical Power Generation
options.B: Pollution and Waste Control Equipment

options.D: Water and Wastewater Equipment
options.E: Electrical

questions.explanation: Division 48 is Electrical Power Generation, in the Process Equipment Subgroup between the two reserved numbers 47 and 49. It covers power generation equipment, combined heat and power generation, and power generation testing. Facility Electrical Power Generating and Storing Equipment is a level 2 title in Division 26, Electrical (26 30 00), for equipment such as packaged generators serving a building.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, which division number is titled Electrical Power Generation?

options.A: Division 48 (48 00 00)

options.E: Division 26 (26 00 00)
options.F: Division 49 (49 00 00)

questions.explanation: Electrical Power Generation is Division 48 (48 00 00), in the Process Equipment Subgroup, between the reserved Divisions 47 and 49. It covers power generation equipment and combined heat and power. Division 26, Electrical, covers distribution and lighting for the facility, including the facility's own generating and storing equipment, and Division 49 has no title.

questions.explanation: Within the Facility Services Subgroup, Divisions 20, 24 and 29 are reserved for future expansion and carry no title. questions.explanation: Divisions 15 through 20 and Division 47 are reserved for future expansion, so the statements about 20, 15 and 47 are all true and {F} is right; {E} leaves out Division 47. Division 16 is also reserved and has no title, since electrical work is Division 26, in the Facility Services Subgroup.

questions.question: In MasterFormat, which of these divisions are reserved (have no title)?

options.A: Division 31
options.B: Division 30

options.E: Division 37

questions.explanation: The Site and Infrastructure Subgroup spans Divisions 30 through 39. Division 30 and Divisions 36 through 39 are reserved; the titled ones are Earthwork (31), Exterior Improvements (32), Utilities (33), Transportation (34), and Waterway and Marine Construction (35). Of the choices, only 30 and 37 are reserved.

questions.question: A permanent 8-foot chain link fence with barbed wire and a motorized slide gate encloses a truck yard. Which section titles hold the fence and the gate's motor operator?

options.A: 32 31 13 Chain Link Fences and Gates
options.B: 01 56 26 Temporary Fencing
options.C: 10 22 13 Wire Mesh Partitions
options.D: 32 31 11 Gate Operators
options.E: 08 71 13 Power Door Operators
options.F: 32 31 16 Welded Wire Fences and Gates

questions.explanation: The fence is 32 31 13 Chain Link Fences and Gates and its motor is 32 31 11 Gate Operators, both under 32 31 00 Fences and Gates in Division 32, Exterior Improvements; 32 31 16 is a different fence type, welded wire. Temporary Fencing (01 56 26) is only the contractor's fence during construction, Power Door Operators (08 71 13) serve doors, and Wire Mesh Partitions (10 22 13) are interior mesh partitions.

questions.question: An owner wants IP surveillance cameras at every building entrance, recording to network video recorders. The cameras will run on the building's data network. Which division holds the requirements for the cameras?

options.A: Division 28 - Electronic Safety and Security
options.B: Division 27 - Communications
options.C: Division 26 - Electrical
options.D: Division 25 - Integrated Automation
options.E: Division 11 - Equipment
options.F: Division 13 - Special Construction

questions.explanation: Surveillance cameras, IP cameras included, are 28 21 00 Surveillance Cameras under 28 20 00 Video Surveillance in Division 28, Electronic Safety and Security. Running on the data network does not move them to Division 27, Communications, which holds the network itself, such as 27 10 00 Structured Cabling. Division 25 covers integrated automation controls, not security cameras.

questions.question: Fixed, drainable extruded-aluminum blade assemblies are set in an exterior masonry wall opening to bring outdoor air to a ducted air-handling unit. Which section title holds them?

options.A: 23 37 13 Diffusers, Registers, and Grilles
options.B: 10 82 00 Grilles and Screens
options.C: 08 92 00 Louvered Equipment Enclosures
options.D: 08 91 00 Louvers
options.E: 08 95 00 Vents
options.F: 23 37 23 HVAC Gravity Ventilators

questions.explanation: Wall louvers that fill an opening in the building envelope are 08 91 00 Louvers (fixed louvers are 08 91 19) in Division 08, Openings. Division 23's air outlets and inlets cover 23 37 13 Diffusers, Registers, and Grilles and 23 37 23 HVAC Gravity Ventilators, not wall louvers; 08 92 00 is louvered enclosures that screen equipment, and 08 95 00 Vents covers soffit, wall and other vents.

questions.question: A clinic gets 4-inch rubber cove base in the corridors and clear-finished wood base with shoe molding in the executive offices. Which section titles hold these two base types?

options.A: 09 65 13 Resilient Base and Accessories
options.B: 09 64 00 Wood Flooring
options.C: 10 26 00 Wall and Door Protection
options.D: 06 46 00 Wood Trim
options.E: 06 42 00 Wood Paneling
options.F: 09 65 16 Resilient Sheet Flooring

questions.explanation: Rubber cove base is 09 65 13 Resilient Base and Accessories, but wood base stays in Division 06: 06 46 00 Wood Trim includes Wood Base and Shoe Moldings (06 46 19). Wood base is not part of 09 64 00 Wood Flooring or 06 42 00 Wood Paneling, and 10 26 00 Wall and Door Protection covers corner guards, bumper guards and protective wall coverings, not base.

questions.question: Where carpet tile in an open office meets luxury vinyl tile, the drawings call for a rubber reducer strip. Which section title holds the strip?

options.A: 09 68 00 Carpeting
options.B: 12 48 13 Entrance Floor Mats and Frames
options.C: 09 65 13 Resilient Base and Accessories
options.D: 09 05 61 Common Work Results for Flooring Preparation
options.E: 09 65 19 Resilient Tile Flooring
options.F: 09 68 13 Tile Carpeting

questions.explanation: Resilient Carpet Transitions are 09 65 13.36, an accessory under 09 65 13 Resilient Base and Accessories, alongside resilient base, stair treads and nosings. The strip meets the carpet, but 09 68 00 Carpeting and 09 68 13 Tile Carpeting cover the carpet itself, 09 65 19 covers the resilient tile, and 09 05 61 is preparation of the floor substrate.

questions.question: Extruded polystyrene is adhered to the outside of a basement wall, over the waterproofing, to meet the energy code's below-grade R-value. Which section title holds it?

options.A: 07 21 13 Board Insulation
options.B: 31 23 23.43 Geofoam
options.C: 07 22 00 Roof and Deck Insulation
options.D: 07 11 00 Dampproofing
options.E: 07 13 00 Sheet Waterproofing
options.F: 07 21 19 Foamed-In-Place Insulation

questions.explanation: Insulation boards, above or below grade, are 07 21 13 Board Insulation, which includes foam board insulation (07 21 13.13). Geofoam at 31 23 23.43 is foam block listed under fill in earthwork, not wall insulation; 07 22 00 is for roof and deck insulation, and the dampproofing or waterproofing under the board has its own section.

questions.question: Semi-recessed, fire-rated steel cabinets holding portable extinguishers are spaced along a school corridor. Which section titles hold the cabinets and the extinguishers?

options.A: 21 12 00 Fire-Suppression Standpipes
options.B: 10 44 13 Fire Protection Cabinets
options.C: 10 44 19 Fire Blankets
options.D: 28 46 00 Fire Detection and Alarm
options.E: 10 44 16 Fire Extinguishers
options.F: 21 20 00 Fire-Extinguishing Systems

questions.explanation: The cabinets are 10 44 13 Fire Protection Cabinets and the extinguishers are 10 44 16 Fire Extinguishers, both under 10 44 00 Fire Protection Specialties, next to 10 44 19 Fire Blankets. Fire-Extinguishing Systems (21 20 00) and standpipes (21 12 00) are fixed suppression systems in Division 21, not portable equipment, and 28 46 00 is fire detection and alarm.

questions.question: A 30-by-36-inch insulated, curbed access door with a lift-up cover is set in a low-slope roof and reached from a ship's ladder below. Which section title holds it?

options.A: 08 31 00 Access Doors and Panels
options.B: 05 51 33 Metal Ladders
options.C: 08 62 00 Unit Skylights
options.D: 07 72 33 Roof Hatches
options.E: 07 72 36 Smoke Vents
options.F: 07 72 13 Manufactured Curbs

questions.explanation: Roof hatches are 07 72 33 Roof Hatches, under 07 72 00 Roof Accessories in Division 07. The unit works like an access door, but 08 31 00 Access Doors and Panels covers access doors, panels and floor doors, not roof hatches; the ship's ladder is a separate item at 05 51 33 Metal Ladders, and 07 72 13 Manufactured Curbs are separate curbs, not the hatch unit.

questions.question: A seismic joint crosses a hospital corridor floor and runs up the walls. A prefabricated aluminum assembly will span the joint and allow movement. Which section title holds it?

options.A: 07 95 13 Expansion Joint Cover Assemblies
options.B: 07 92 00 Joint Sealants
options.C: 07 91 00 Preformed Joint Seals
options.D: 05 50 00 Metal Fabrications
options.E: 07 71 29 Manufactured Roof Expansion Joints
options.F: 03 15 16 Concrete Construction Joints

questions.explanation: Prefabricated covers that span building joints are 07 95 13 Expansion Joint Cover Assemblies (interior ones are 07 95 13.13), under 07 95 00 Expansion Control. Being aluminum does not put the assembly in 05 50 00 Metal Fabrications; 07 92 00 and 07 91 00 are joint sealants and preformed seals rather than cover assemblies, and 07 71 29 is for roof expansion joints.

questions.question: On a high-rise, mineral wool and smoke sealant fill the gap between each floor slab edge and the inside face of the curtain wall. Which section title holds this work?

options.A: 07 84 13 Penetration Firestopping
options.B: 08 44 00 Curtain Wall and Glazed Assemblies
options.C: 07 84 53 Building Perimeter Firestopping
options.D: 07 95 00 Expansion Control
options.E: 07 21 16 Blanket Insulation
options.F: 07 81 00 Applied Fire Protection

questions.explanation: Filling the gap between a slab edge and the curtain wall is 07 84 53 Building Perimeter Firestopping, under 07 84 00 Firestopping. The mineral wool here acts as firestopping, not as 07 21 16 Blanket Insulation; the work touches the curtain wall but is not part of 08 44 00; and 07 84 13 Penetration Firestopping is for pipes, ducts and cables that pass through rated assemblies.

questions.question: Sawcut control joints in a new concrete parking lot are to be filled with a fuel-resistant sealant. Which section title holds the sealant?

options.A: 07 92 00 Joint Sealants
options.B: 32 13 73 Concrete Paving Joint Sealants
options.C: 03 15 00 Concrete Accessories
options.D: 32 12 73 Asphalt Paving Joint Sealants
options.E: 32 13 13 Concrete Paving
options.F: 07 91 00 Preformed Joint Seals

questions.explanation: Joints in site concrete paving have their own title, 32 13 73 Concrete Paving Joint Sealants, in 32 13 00 Rigid Paving, and a fuel-resistant product is a Level 4 title under it. 07 92 00 Joint Sealants covers sealants in building joints, 32 12 73 is the matching title for asphalt paving, and 32 13 13 Concrete Paving is the slab itself, not the joint filler.

questions.question: An elevator hoistway in a steel-framed office building is enclosed with a 2-hour gypsum board shaft wall built from the corridor side. Which statements about where this work goes are correct?

options.A: The shaft wall goes in 09 21 16.23 Gypsum Board Shaft Wall Assemblies.
options.B: The elevator itself goes in Division 14 Conveying Equipment.
options.C: The shaft wall goes in Division 14, since it encloses the hoistway.
options.D: The shaft wall goes in Division 07, with the fire and smoke protection.
options.E: Both {A} and {B}
options.F: Both {B} and {C}

questions.explanation: A gypsum shaft wall is a gypsum board assembly, 09 21 16.23 Gypsum Board Shaft Wall Assemblies, under 09 21 00 Plaster and Gypsum Board Assemblies, while the elevator itself is Division 14 Conveying Equipment. The wall encloses the hoistway but is not conveying equipment, and 07 80 00 Fire and Smoke Protection covers items such as applied fire protection and firestopping, not rated gypsum assemblies.

questions.question: A 4-story building has load-bearing cold-formed steel stud exterior walls that carry the floors, and non-load-bearing steel stud interior partitions. Which section titles hold these two kinds of framing?

options.A: 05 41 00 Structural Metal Stud Framing
options.B: 05 12 00 Structural Steel Framing
options.C: 05 44 00 Cold-Formed Metal Trusses
options.D: 09 22 16 Non-Structural Metal Framing
options.E: 05 42 00 Cold-Formed Metal Joist Framing
options.F: 06 11 00 Wood Framing

questions.explanation: Load-bearing cold-formed studs are 05 41 00 Structural Metal Stud Framing, under 05 40 00 Cold-Formed Metal Framing. Partition studs that carry no load are 09 22 16 Non-Structural Metal Framing, under 09 22 00 Supports for Plaster and Gypsum Board, even though the material is the same. 05 12 00 is hot-rolled structural steel, and 05 42 00 and 05 44 00 cover joists and trusses, not studs.

questions.question: A storage room door gets a battery-powered keypad lockset that stores its own codes and has no wiring or network link to anything else. MasterFormat gives this hardware its own Level 2 title. Which is it?

options.A: 28 15 00 Integrated Access Control Hardware Devices
options.B: 08 74 00 Non-Integrated Access Control Hardware
options.C: 28 14 00 Access Control System Hardware
options.D: 08 71 00 Door Hardware
options.E: 08 79 00 Hardware Accessories
options.F: 28 13 00 Access Control Software and Database Management

questions.explanation: A stand-alone keypad lock is non-integrated hardware: MasterFormat lists keypad units under 08 74 00 Non-Integrated Access Control Hardware in Division 08, separate from 08 71 00 Door Hardware. Readers and keypads that tie into a networked access control system go to Division 28 instead, at 28 15 00 Integrated Access Control Hardware Devices.

questions.question: Horizontal aluminum sunshade blades are cantilevered from the outside of a curtain wall to cut solar gain on the south face. Which division holds the sunshades?

options.A: Division 12 - Furnishings
options.B: Division 08 - Openings
options.C: Division 10 - Specialties
options.D: Division 05 - Metals
options.E: Division 07 - Thermal and Moisture Protection
options.F: Division 13 - Special Construction

questions.explanation: Exterior sunshades are 10 71 13 Exterior Sun Control Devices, under 10 71 00 Exterior Protection in Division 10, a title that also covers fixed sun screens and exterior shutters. The curtain wall they hang from is Division 08, and interior blinds and shades are 12 20 00 Window Treatments, but exterior sun control devices have their own Division 10 title.

questions.question: A custom plastic-laminate reception desk and wall cabinets will be shop-built to the project drawings. Which section title fits?

options.A: 12 32 00 Manufactured Wood Casework
options.B: 06 22 00 Millwork
options.C: 12 35 53 Laboratory Casework
options.D: 06 41 00 Architectural Wood Casework
options.E: 12 32 16 Manufactured Plastic-Laminate-Clad Casework
options.F: 06 42 00 Wood Paneling

questions.explanation: Custom cabinets built in a shop to the project drawings are 06 41 00 Architectural Wood Casework, which includes plastic-laminate-clad architectural cabinets. 12 32 00 Manufactured Wood Casework, with its plastic-laminate-clad subtitle, is catalog casework from a casework manufacturer, so the split is custom fabrication versus a manufactured product. 06 22 00 Millwork is standard pattern wood trim, not cabinets.

questions.question: Granite countertops are fabricated and installed on manufactured casework in a staff break room. Which statements about where this work goes are correct?

options.A: The countertops go in 12 36 40 Stone Countertops.
options.B: The manufactured casework also goes in Division 12.
options.C: Stone laid as a floor finish would go in 09 63 40 Stone Flooring.
options.D: The countertops go in Division 04, because granite is stone.
options.E: Both {A} and {B}
options.F: {A}, {B} and {C}

questions.explanation: Countertops have their own title, 12 36 00 Countertops, and granite tops are 12 36 40 Stone Countertops, in Division 12 with the manufactured casework (12 30 00 Casework), while stone laid as a floor finish is 09 63 40 Stone Flooring. All three statements are true. Natural stone does not pull the tops into Division 04, whose 04 40 00 Stone Assemblies is masonry work.

questions.question: A building gets internally illuminated LED exit signs with integral battery backup, wired to the lighting circuits, plus non-electric photoluminescent exit markings in the stairs. Which section titles hold these two items?

options.A: 26 52 13 Emergency and Exit Lighting
options.B: 10 14 00 Signage
options.C: 10 45 00 Photoluminescent Exit Specialties
options.D: 28 46 00 Fire Detection and Alarm
options.E: 26 51 00 Interior Lighting
options.F: 10 44 00 Fire Protection Specialties

questions.explanation: Electrically lit exit signs are listed under 26 52 13 Emergency and Exit Lighting, while non-electric markings that glow in the dark have their own title, 10 45 00 Photoluminescent Exit Specialties. 10 14 00 Signage is for room and wayfinding signs, 26 51 00 Interior Lighting is normal lighting, and 28 46 00 Fire Detection and Alarm holds the alarm devices.

questions.question: A motorized, roll-up vinyl-and-mesh curtain drops from the roof structure to split a high school gym into two practice courts. Which section title holds it?

options.A: 10 22 00 Partitions
options.B: 11 61 43 Stage Curtains
options.C: 11 66 53 Gymnasium Dividers
options.D: 11 66 23 Gymnasium Equipment
options.E: 10 22 36 Coiling Partitions
options.F: 11 61 33 Rigging Systems and Controls

questions.explanation: Gym divider curtains are 11 66 53 Gymnasium Dividers, under 11 66 00 Athletic Equipment in Division 11. 11 66 23 Gymnasium Equipment covers items such as basketball and volleyball equipment and wall padding, not dividers. Because gym dividers have their own athletic-equipment title, the general Division 10 partition titles, such as 10 22 36 Coiling Partitions, are not used for them.

questions.question: A restaurant's cooking line gets a listed Type I grease exhaust hood connected to a grease duct and exhaust fan, laid out by the foodservice consultant. Which statements about where this work goes are correct?

options.A: The hood goes in 23 38 13 Commercial-Kitchen Hoods.
options.B: The ranges and fryers under the hood go in Division 11.
options.C: The hood goes in Division 11, since the foodservice consultant lays it out.
options.D: The exhaust fan goes in Division 22 Plumbing.
options.E: Both {A} and {B}
options.F: Both {A} and {D}

questions.explanation: Kitchen exhaust hoods are 23 38 13 Commercial-Kitchen Hoods, under 23 38 00 Ventilation Hoods in Division 23, and the exhaust fan is HVAC work too (23 34 00 HVAC Fans). Division 11 lists the cooking equipment under the hood, at 11 44 00 Food Cooking Equipment, but not the hood itself, even when the foodservice consultant lays it out.

questions.question: An addressable fire alarm system includes the control panel, smoke detectors, manual pull stations, and horn/strobes. Which division holds it?

options.A: Division 28 - Electronic Safety and Security
options.B: Division 21 - Fire Suppression
options.C: Division 26 - Electrical
options.D: Division 27 - Communications
options.E: Division 25 - Integrated Automation
options.F: Division 23 - Heating, Ventilating, and Air Conditioning (HVAC)

questions.explanation: Fire alarm is 28 46 00 Fire Detection and Alarm, which includes 28 46 13 Fire-Alarm Systems, in Division 28 Electronic Safety and Security. Division 21 holds suppression systems such as sprinklers and fire pumps, and Division 26 is power and lighting, not detection and signaling.

questions.question: An open-plan office gets ceiling loudspeakers that emit a low background sound to improve speech privacy. Which division holds the requirements for this system?

options.A: Division 09 - Finishes
options.B: Division 27 - Communications
options.C: Division 13 - Special Construction
options.D: Division 23 - Heating, Ventilating, and Air Conditioning (HVAC)
options.E: Division 11 - Equipment
options.F: Division 28 - Electronic Safety and Security

questions.explanation: Sound masking is 27 51 19 Sound Masking Systems, under 27 51 00 Distributed Audio-Video Communications Systems, next to paging and public address. The goal is acoustic, but Division 09 acoustical finishes are passive materials, and 13 48 00 Sound, Vibration, and Seismic Control covers isolation components, not an active loudspeaker system.

questions.question: A hospital tower needs a UL-listed lightning protection system: roof air terminals, down conductors, and ground rods. In MasterFormat 2020, which division holds it?

options.A: Division 26 - Electrical
options.B: Division 07 - Thermal and Moisture Protection
options.C: Division 13 - Special Construction
options.D: Division 33 - Utilities
options.E: Division 28 - Electronic Safety and Security
options.F: Division 05 - Metals

questions.explanation: MasterFormat places lightning protection in Special Construction at 13 46 00 Lightning Protection Systems, whose first Level 3 title covers protection for structures. Division 26 has 26 40 00 Electrical Protection, but it lists items such as 26 43 00 Surge Protective Devices, not the air terminals and down conductors that protect the building itself.

questions.question: A school installs a rooftop solar array with inverters that feed the building's own electrical service. Which section title holds the solar panels?

options.A: 48 14 00 Solar Energy Electrical Power Generation Equipment
options.B: 23 56 00 Solar Energy Heating Equipment
options.C: 26 32 00 Packaged Generator Assemblies
options.D: 26 31 00 Photovoltaic Collectors
options.E: 26 33 00 Battery Equipment
options.F: 26 35 00 Power Filters and Conditioners

questions.explanation: Solar panels that feed a building's own electrical service are 26 31 00 Photovoltaic Collectors, in the Division 26 group for facility power generating and storing equipment. Division 48 Electrical Power Generation is for generating plants, with titles such as fossil fuel, nuclear and hydroelectric plant equipment, and 23 56 00 Solar Energy Heating Equipment collects heat, not electricity.

questions.question: A parking garage gets twelve Level 2 electric vehicle charging stations on pedestals, fed from a new panelboard. Which statements about where this work goes are correct?

options.A: The charging stations go in Division 11, at 11 11 36 Vehicle Charging Equipment.
options.B: The new panelboard goes in Division 26, at 26 24 16 Panelboards.
options.C: The charging stations go in Division 26, because they are electrical.
options.D: Both {A} and {B}
options.E: Both {B} and {C}
options.F: {A}, {B} and {C}

questions.explanation: EV chargers are equipment: 11 11 36 Vehicle Charging Equipment, under 11 11 00 Vehicle Service Equipment, which lists a commercial electric vehicle charging unit. The feeders and the new panelboard (26 24 16 Panelboards) are Division 26, but being electrical does not move the chargers themselves out of Division 11.

questions.question: Clay brick pavers are laid in a herringbone pattern on a sand setting bed over an aggregate base at a university plaza. Which section titles hold the pavers and the aggregate base?

options.A: 32 14 16 Brick Unit Paving
options.B: 04 21 13 Brick Masonry
options.C: 09 63 13 Brick Flooring
options.D: 32 11 23 Aggregate Base Courses
options.E: 32 14 13 Precast Concrete Unit Paving
options.F: 32 13 13 Concrete Paving

questions.explanation: Brick laid as site paving is 32 14 16 Brick Unit Paving, under 32 14 00 Unit Paving, and the base below it is 32 11 23 Aggregate Base Courses, under 32 11 00 Base Courses. Clay brick in a wall is 04 21 13 Brick Masonry and brick laid as an interior floor is 09 63 13 Brick Flooring, but brick used as exterior paving goes with the other paving in Division 32.

questions.question: On a rooftop terrace, 2-foot-square concrete pavers sit on adjustable pedestals over the roofing membrane and insulation. Which section title holds the pavers?

options.A: 32 14 13 Precast Concrete Unit Paving
options.B: 07 76 00 Roof Pavers
options.C: 07 72 46 Roof Walkways
options.D: 03 41 00 Precast Structural Concrete
options.E: 07 72 43 Roof Walk Boards
options.F: 03 48 00 Precast Concrete Specialties

questions.explanation: Pavers set over a roof assembly are 07 76 00 Roof Pavers, which divides into roof ballast pavers and roof decking pavers. 32 14 13 Precast Concrete Unit Paving is site paving on grade, even when the paver looks identical, and roof walkways and walk boards are roof accessories under 07 72 00, not paver surfaces.

questions.question: After a parking lot is paved, the contractor paints stall striping, directional arrows, and accessible-space symbols. Which division holds this work?

options.A: Division 09 - Finishes
options.B: Division 10 - Specialties
options.C: Division 32 - Exterior Improvements
options.D: Division 34 - Transportation
options.E: Division 07 - Thermal and Moisture Protection
options.F: Division 11 - Equipment

questions.explanation: Stall striping, arrows and symbols are 32 17 23 Pavement Markings, under 32 17 00 Paving Specialties in Division 32, which lists painted markings as a Level 4 title. The work is paint, but 09 91 00 Painting is for building surfaces, 07 18 00 Traffic Coatings is a wearing surface for decks, and post-mounted parking signs would be 10 14 53 Traffic Signage.

questions.question: A city park plaza gets freestanding benches, picnic tables, and litter receptacles anchored to the paving. Which section titles hold the seating and the receptacles?

options.A: 12 93 00 Interior Public Space Furnishings
options.B: 32 39 00 Manufactured Site Specialties
options.C: 32 33 43 Site Seating and Tables
options.D: 11 68 00 Play Field Equipment and Structures
options.E: 32 33 23 Site Trash and Litter Receptacles
options.F: 32 33 33 Site Manufactured Planters

questions.explanation: Outdoor benches and picnic tables are 32 33 43 Site Seating and Tables, and the receptacles are 32 33 23 Site Trash and Litter Receptacles, both under 32 33 00 Site Furnishings, which also lists bicycle racks and site manufactured planters. 12 93 00 Interior Public Space Furnishings holds the indoor versions, and 32 39 00 Manufactured Site Specialties covers items such as bollards and fire pits.

questions.question: A corporate campus lawn gets pop-up rotor heads, zone valves, and a controller fed from the domestic water service. Which division holds the requirements for this sprinkler system?

options.A: Division 21 - Fire Suppression
options.B: Division 22 - Plumbing
options.C: Division 32 - Exterior Improvements
options.D: Division 33 - Utilities
options.E: Division 46 - Water and Wastewater Equipment
options.F: Division 25 - Integrated Automation

questions.explanation: Lawn sprinklers are 32 84 23 Underground Sprinklers, under 32 84 00 Planting Irrigation in Division 32. The word sprinkler points toward Division 21, but that is fire suppression, and Division 22 Plumbing covers the building's water systems, not landscape irrigation.

questions.question: A flat roof has cast-iron roof drains with strainer domes, connected to rainwater leaders that run down through the building. Which section titles hold the drains and the leaders?

options.A: 07 71 23 Manufactured Gutters and Downspouts
options.B: 22 14 26.13 Roof Drains
options.C: 33 42 11 Stormwater Gravity Piping
options.D: 07 71 33 Manufactured Scuppers
options.E: 22 14 16 Rainwater Leaders
options.F: 22 14 19 Sump Pump Discharge Piping

questions.explanation: Roof drains (22 14 26.13) and rainwater leaders (22 14 16) are both in 22 14 00 Facility Storm Drainage, because they carry rainwater through the building. Division 07 holds roof-edge drainage such as 07 71 23 Manufactured Gutters and Downspouts and 07 71 33 Manufactured Scuppers, and 33 42 11 Stormwater Gravity Piping is the site system outside the building.

questions.question: A perforated drain pipe in a gravel envelope runs along the footing of a basement wall and discharges to daylight. Which division holds this foundation drain?

options.A: Division 31 - Earthwork
options.B: Division 22 - Plumbing
options.C: Division 07 - Thermal and Moisture Protection
options.D: Division 33 - Utilities
options.E: Division 32 - Exterior Improvements
options.F: Division 03 - Concrete

questions.explanation: A perforated footing drain is 33 41 13 Foundation Drainage, under 33 41 00 Subdrainage in the stormwater utilities group of Division 33. It is placed during the earthwork and protects the below-grade waterproofing, but MasterFormat files it as a utility, not under Division 31 Earthwork or Division 07.

questions.question: Groundwater sits 6 feet above the bottom of a planned excavation, so the contractor will run wellpoints and pumps until the foundations are backfilled. Which division holds the dewatering requirements?

options.A: Division 31 - Earthwork
options.B: Division 01 - General Requirements
options.C: Division 33 - Utilities
options.D: Division 22 - Plumbing
options.E: Division 02 - Existing Conditions
options.F: Division 35 - Waterway and Marine Construction

questions.explanation: Dewatering is 31 23 19 Dewatering, under 31 23 00 Excavation and Fill in Division 31 Earthwork. Its temporary nature tempts Division 01, but 01 57 00 Temporary Controls covers items such as erosion and sediment control, pest control and dust control, and the wells in Division 33 are groundwater sources for water supply.

questions.question: Before the slab on grade is placed, a licensed applicator treats the prepared subgrade with a liquid termiticide. Which division holds this treatment?

options.A: Division 03 - Concrete
options.B: Division 02 - Existing Conditions
options.C: Division 07 - Thermal and Moisture Protection
options.D: Division 31 - Earthwork
options.E: Division 01 - General Requirements
options.F: Division 10 - Specialties

questions.explanation: Treating soil with a termiticide is 31 31 16 Termite Control, under 31 31 00 Soil Treatment, which lists chemical termite control. Division 03 does have 03 15 21 Termite Barrier, but that is a concrete accessory; 01 57 00 Temporary Controls covers temporary measures during construction, and 10 81 00 Pest Control Devices are installed products, not a soil treatment.

questions.question: Permanent post-tensioned anchors are drilled through a mat slab into bedrock to resist hydrostatic uplift for the life of the building. Which section title holds them?

options.A: 31 51 00 Anchor Tiebacks
options.B: 31 68 00 Foundation Anchors
options.C: 31 33 00 Rock Stabilization
options.D: 03 15 00 Concrete Accessories
options.E: 31 63 00 Bored Piles
options.F: 03 15 19 Cast-In Concrete Anchors

questions.explanation: Permanent anchors that hold a structure down are 31 68 00 Foundation Anchors, which include rock foundation anchors and helical foundation anchors. 31 51 00 Anchor Tiebacks are excavation support (excavation soil and rock anchors), and 31 33 00 Rock Stabilization covers rock bolting and slope netting, not hold-downs for a building.

questions.question: To make a stage 48 inches above the floor accessible, a school adds an unenclosed vertical accessibility lift with side guards and constant-pressure controls. Which section title holds it?

options.A: 14 43 00 Platform Lifts
options.B: 14 26 00 Limited-Use/Limited-Application Elevators
options.C: 14 42 00 Wheelchair Lifts
options.D: 14 41 00 People Lifts
options.E: 14 42 13 Inclined Wheelchair Lifts
options.F: 14 45 00 Vehicle Lifts

questions.explanation: An unenclosed vertical accessibility lift falls under 14 42 00 Wheelchair Lifts, which has separate titles for vertical lifts and for the inclined, stair-following type (14 42 13). The stage setting tempts 14 43 00 Platform Lifts, but that title holds orchestra lifts and stage lifts, which raise part of the floor or stage itself. A LULA elevator with a cab and hoistway is 14 26 00.

questions.question: Before a building addition starts, an existing asphalt parking lot and an abandoned water line are removed. Which section title holds this removal work?

options.A: 02 41 19 Selective Demolition
options.B: 02 41 16 Structure Demolition
options.C: 31 11 00 Clearing and Grubbing
options.D: 02 41 13 Selective Site Demolition
options.E: 02 65 00 Underground Storage Tank Removal
options.F: 31 23 16 Excavation

questions.explanation: Removing site elements such as paving and buried utilities is 02 41 13 Selective Site Demolition, which lists paving removal and utility line removal. 02 41 19 Selective Demolition is for removing parts of a building, 02 41 16 Structure Demolition removes whole structures, and 31 11 00 Clearing and Grubbing removes vegetation.

questions.question: A survey found asbestos in the existing vinyl floor tile and mastic. Before the renovation, a licensed contractor will remove and dispose of it under containment. Which section title holds the removal?

options.A: 02 26 23 Asbestos Assessment
options.B: 02 82 00 Asbestos Remediation
options.C: 02 41 19 Selective Demolition
options.D: 01 35 43 Environmental Procedures
options.E: 02 83 00 Lead Remediation
options.F: 02 84 00 Polychlorinate Biphenyl Remediation

questions.explanation: Removing asbestos under containment is remediation: 02 82 00 Asbestos Remediation, in 02 80 00 Facility Remediation, which even has an abatement title for asbestos floor tile and mastic. 02 26 23 Asbestos Assessment is the survey that found the asbestos, not its removal, and 02 41 19 Selective Demolition is general removal work without hazardous-material procedures.

questions.question: PVC waterstops are cast into the construction joints of a below-grade concrete foundation wall. Which statements about where this work goes are correct?

options.A: The waterstops go in 03 15 13 Waterstops.
options.B: A sheet membrane applied to the outside of the same wall would go in Division 07.
options.C: Bentonite waterproofing on the wall would go in Division 07.
options.D: The waterstops go in Division 07, because they keep water out.
options.E: Both {A} and {B}
options.F: {A}, {B} and {C}

questions.explanation: Waterstops are cast into the concrete, so they are 03 15 13 Waterstops, under 03 15 00 Concrete Accessories. Membranes applied to the face of the wall, such as 07 13 00 Sheet Waterproofing and 07 17 00 Bentonite Waterproofing, are Division 07, so all three placement statements are true. Keeping water out does not move the waterstop itself to Division 07.

questions.question: In a wood-framed apartment building, a poured gypsum cement underlayment is placed over the subfloor before LVT goes down. Which section title holds the pour?

options.A: 03 54 00 Cast Underlayment
options.B: 09 05 61 Common Work Results for Flooring Preparation
options.C: 06 16 26 Underlayment
options.D: 09 05 71 Acoustic Underlayment
options.E: 03 53 00 Concrete Topping
options.F: 03 52 00 Lightweight Concrete Roof Insulation

questions.explanation: Poured gypsum underlayment is 03 54 13 Gypsum Cement Underlayment, under 03 54 00 Cast Underlayment in Division 03, even in a wood-framed building. 06 16 26 Underlayment is a panel product under 06 16 00 Sheathing, and 09 05 61 Common Work Results for Flooring Preparation covers items such as moisture vapor emission control, not a poured underlayment.

questions.question: Adjustable two-piece veneer anchors tie a brick veneer to cold-formed steel stud backup walls. Which section title holds the anchors?

options.A: 05 05 23 Metal Fastenings
options.B: 03 15 19 Cast-In Concrete Anchors
options.C: 05 41 00 Structural Metal Stud Framing
options.D: 04 05 19 Masonry Anchorage and Reinforcing
options.E: 04 05 23 Masonry Accessories
options.F: 05 05 19 Post-Installed Concrete Anchors

questions.explanation: Veneer ties are masonry anchors, listed under 04 05 19 Masonry Anchorage and Reinforcing in Division 04. They screw into the steel studs, but 05 05 23 Metal Fastenings covers general fasteners, and 04 05 23 Masonry Accessories covers items such as control joints, embedded flashing and weeps, not anchors.

questions.question: Exit stairs in a parking structure use steel channel stringers, formed sheet-steel treads filled with concrete, and pipe handrails. Which section title holds the stairs?

options.A: 05 51 13 Metal Pan Stairs
options.B: 05 71 00 Decorative Metal Stairs
options.C: 03 41 00 Precast Structural Concrete
options.D: 05 12 00 Structural Steel Framing
options.E: 05 51 19 Metal Grating Stairs
options.F: 05 52 13 Pipe and Tube Railings

questions.explanation: Stairs with formed steel pans filled with concrete are 05 51 13 Metal Pan Stairs, under 05 51 00 Metal Stairs in 05 50 00 Metal Fabrications. The concrete fill does not make them Division 03, the handrails alone would be 05 52 13 Pipe and Tube Railings, and 05 71 00 Decorative Metal Stairs is for decorative feature stairs, not utility exit stairs.

questions.question: Metal-plate-connected wood roof trusses will be designed by the truss manufacturer's engineer and delivered to the site. Which section title holds them?

options.A: 06 11 00 Wood Framing
options.B: 06 13 26 Heavy Timber Trusses
options.C: 06 17 53 Shop-Fabricated Wood Trusses
options.D: 05 44 00 Cold-Formed Metal Trusses
options.E: 06 17 33 Wood I-Joists
options.F: 06 18 00 Glued-Laminated Construction

questions.explanation: Trusses engineered and built by a truss fabricator are 06 17 53 Shop-Fabricated Wood Trusses, under 06 17 00 Shop-Fabricated Structural Wood. The steel connector plates do not move them to 05 44 00 Cold-Formed Metal Trusses, 06 11 00 Wood Framing is lumber framed on site, and 06 13 26 Heavy Timber Trusses belong to timber construction.

questions.question: Exterior-grade gypsum panels are screwed to the outside of exterior steel stud walls, behind a fluid-applied air barrier and brick veneer. Which section title holds the panels?

options.A: 09 29 00 Gypsum Board
options.B: 06 16 43 Gypsum Sheathing
options.C: 09 28 16 Glass-Mat Faced Gypsum Backing Boards
options.D: 07 25 00 Weather Barriers
options.E: 07 27 00 Air Barriers
options.F: 06 16 13 Insulating Sheathing

questions.explanation: Exterior gypsum sheathing is 06 16 43 Gypsum Sheathing, under 06 16 00 Sheathing with the other sheathing products. The boards under 09 28 00 are backing boards for finishes such as tile, 09 29 00 Gypsum Board is interior wallboard, and the air barrier applied over the panels is its own item, 07 27 00 Air Barriers.

questions.question: Three-coat portland cement stucco on metal lath is applied over the exterior sheathing of a hotel. Which division holds the stucco?

options.A: Division 07 - Thermal and Moisture Protection
options.B: Division 04 - Masonry
options.C: Division 03 - Concrete
options.D: Division 09 - Finishes
options.E: Division 05 - Metals
options.F: Division 06 - Wood, Plastics, and Composites

questions.explanation: Portland cement stucco is 09 24 23 Cement Stucco, under 09 24 00 Cement Plastering in Division 09, even when it is an exterior finish. The look-alike Division 07 system is EIFS, 07 24 00 Exterior Insulation and Finish Systems, and the metal lath behind the stucco is itself a Division 09 item (09 22 36 Lath), not Division 05.

questions.question: A shower wall and a stair-tower window are built of 8-inch glass block laid in mortar with panel reinforcing. Which division holds the glass block?

options.A: Division 08 - Openings
options.B: Division 04 - Masonry
options.C: Division 09 - Finishes
options.D: Division 10 - Specialties
options.E: Division 07 - Thermal and Moisture Protection
options.F: Division 03 - Concrete

questions.explanation: Glass block is 04 23 00 Glass Unit Masonry, under 04 20 00 Unit Masonry. It admits light like a window, but it is laid up in mortar as masonry units with joint reinforcing, so it is not Division 08 glazing or a Division 09 finish.

questions.question: A 15-mil polyolefin sheet is placed directly under a slab on grade that will receive moisture-sensitive flooring. Which statements about where this work goes are correct?

options.A: The sheet goes in 07 26 16 Below-Grade Vapor Retarders.
options.B: A moisture vapor emission control treatment on top of the slab would go in Division 07, with the sheet.
options.C: The sheet goes in Division 03, with the slab it sits under.
options.D: A below-grade gas retarder would go in Division 31, with radon mitigation.
options.E: Both {A} and {C}
options.F: {A}, {B} and {D}

questions.explanation: Sheets under a slab are 07 26 16 Below-Grade Vapor Retarders, in 07 26 00 Vapor Retarders, and a below-grade gas retarder is 07 26 23 in the same group, not Division 31. Moisture vapor emission control applied to the slab surface is flooring preparation in Division 09 (09 05 61.13), and Division 03 holds the slab, not the membrane under it.

questions.question: Perforated pipe in the gravel under a slab is piped up through the roof to an in-line fan that depressurizes the soil to keep soil gas out. Which section title holds this system?

options.A: 07 26 00 Vapor Retarders
options.B: 33 41 19 Underslab Drainage
options.C: 31 21 13 Radon Mitigation
options.D: 23 34 00 HVAC Fans
options.E: 07 26 23 Below-Grade Gas Retarders
options.F: 33 41 13 Foundation Drainage

questions.explanation: A sub-slab depressurization system is radon mitigation, at 31 21 13 Radon Mitigation under 31 21 00 Off-Gassing Mitigation, and it includes radon venting. Perforated pipe under a slab suggests 33 41 19 Underslab Drainage, but that drains water, a gas membrane would be 07 26 23 Below-Grade Gas Retarders, and the fan is part of the mitigation system rather than general HVAC.

questions.question: A ground-set, 30-foot tapered aluminum flagpole on a concrete foundation is placed in the front lawn of a courthouse. Which division holds the flagpole?

options.A: Division 32 - Exterior Improvements
options.B: Division 05 - Metals
options.C: Division 10 - Specialties
options.D: Division 13 - Special Construction
options.E: Division 12 - Furnishings
options.F: Division 03 - Concrete

questions.explanation: Flagpoles are 10 75 00 Flagpoles in Division 10 Specialties, which lists ground-set, wall-mounted and roof-mounted types, even when the pole stands outdoors. The site location tempts Division 32, but 32 33 00 Site Furnishings covers items such as bike racks, planters, seating and tables, not flagpoles.

questions.question: For a natatorium, the pool basin with its recirculating gutters is specified separately from the pool's recirculation pumps, filters, and chemical treatment equipment. Which section titles hold these two parts of the work?

options.A: 22 51 00 Swimming Pool Plumbing Systems
options.B: 13 11 00 Swimming Pools
options.C: 22 32 00 Domestic Water Filtration Equipment
options.D: 46 30 00 Water and Wastewater Chemical Feed Equipment
options.E: 13 12 00 Fountains
options.F: 11 66 00 Athletic Equipment

questions.explanation: The pool basin and its gutters are 13 11 00 Swimming Pools, which lists recirculating gutter systems. The pumps, filters and water treatment are 22 51 00 Swimming Pool Plumbing Systems, which lists pool pumps and pool water treatment equipment. 22 32 00 Domestic Water Filtration Equipment is for domestic water, and Division 46 is equipment for water and wastewater treatment plants.

questions.question: An owner wants one network, with gateways and a shared operator workstation, that monitors and controls HVAC, lighting, elevators, and security together. Which division holds it?

options.A: Division 23 - Heating, Ventilating, and Air Conditioning (HVAC)
options.B: Division 25 - Integrated Automation
options.C: Division 26 - Electrical
options.D: Division 27 - Communications
options.E: Division 28 - Electronic Safety and Security
options.F: Division 40 - Process Interconnections

questions.explanation: One network that monitors and controls several building systems together is Division 25 Integrated Automation, for example 25 50 00 Integrated Automation Facility Controls. An HVAC-only control system would be 23 09 23 Direct-Digital Control System for HVAC, which is why Division 23 tempts, and Division 40 Process Interconnections serves industrial process systems, not building systems.

questions.question: A 20-story apartment building gets a gravity trash chute with fire-rated intake doors on every floor, discharging to a compactor room. Which statements about where this work goes are correct?

options.A: The chute goes in 14 91 82 Trash Chutes.
options.B: The compactor it feeds goes in 11 82 00 Facility Solid Waste Handling Equipment.
options.C: A mail chute in the same building would go in Division 10.
options.D: The trash chute goes in Division 10, with the mail chutes.
options.E: Both {A} and {B}
options.F: {A}, {B} and {C}

questions.explanation: Trash chutes are 14 91 82 Trash Chutes, under 14 91 00 Facility Chutes in Division 14 Conveying Equipment. The compactor is 11 82 00 Facility Solid Waste Handling Equipment, which lists facility waste compactors, and mail chutes are Division 10 (10 55 91 Mail Chutes), so all three statements are true, and the trash chute does not follow the mail chute into Division 10.

questions.question: The walls around a hospital X-ray room are built as integrated lead-lined shielding assemblies sized from the physicist's report. Which statements about where this work goes are correct?

options.A: The shielded walls go in 13 49 13 Integrated X-Ray Shielding Assemblies.
options.B: The room's shielded doors go in 08 34 49 Radiation Shielding Doors and Frames.
options.C: The lead-lined walls go in Division 09, as gypsum board assemblies.
options.D: The shielding goes in Division 11, with the radiology equipment.
options.E: Both {A} and {B}
options.F: Both {B} and {C}

questions.explanation: Lead-lined X-ray room walls are 13 49 13 Integrated X-Ray Shielding Assemblies, under 13 49 00 Radiation Protection in Division 13, and the shielded doors are 08 34 49 Radiation Shielding Doors and Frames. Lead lining does not make the walls a Division 09 gypsum board item, and 11 77 00 Radiology Equipment is the X-ray equipment, not the room's shielding.

questions.question: A recessed aluminum-framed entrance mat with replaceable carpet inserts is set in a pit in the lobby slab inside the main doors. Which division holds the mat and frame?

options.A: Division 12 - Furnishings
options.B: Division 09 - Finishes
options.C: Division 10 - Specialties
options.D: Division 05 - Metals
options.E: Division 03 - Concrete
options.F: Division 08 - Openings

questions.explanation: Recessed entrance mats and their frames are 12 48 13 Entrance Floor Mats and Frames, under 12 48 00 Rugs and Mats in Division 12 Furnishings. The mat sits flush with the flooring, but Division 09 holds the floor finishes, and the aluminum frame does not make it Division 05 metal work.

questions.question: Pole-mounted LED luminaires light a 300-space surface parking lot at a medical office building. Which division holds the luminaires and poles?

options.A: Division 26 - Electrical
options.B: Division 32 - Exterior Improvements
options.C: Division 34 - Transportation
options.D: Division 33 - Utilities
options.E: Division 05 - Metals
options.F: Division 03 - Concrete

questions.explanation: Site lighting is 26 56 00 Exterior Lighting in Division 26, which lists lighting poles and standards as well as LED exterior lighting. Division 34 Transportation has roadway items such as 34 41 13 Traffic Signals, and Division 32 holds the paving and other site improvements, not the lights.

questions.question: What does the Spearin doctrine hold?

options.A: Ambiguous terms are read against the party that drafted them
options.B: Specific provisions take precedence over general provisions
options.C: The A/E must act as a reasonable, prudent A/E in the same area would
options.D: The contractor may rely on the owner's documents being sufficient
options.E: The A/E impliedly warrants its design directly to the contractor
options.F: A party that fails to enforce a provision may waive that provision

questions.explanation: Under the Spearin doctrine, from the 1918 Supreme Court case United States v. Spearin, the owner impliedly warrants that the drawings and specifications it furnishes are adequate, so a contractor that follows them is not responsible for the results of their errors or omissions. Reading ambiguous terms against the drafter is a separate rule of contract interpretation, and acting like a reasonable, prudent local A/E is the standard of care.

questions.question: Under the Spearin doctrine, who implicitly warrants that the drawings and specifications are adequate, and to whom?

options.A: The owner, to the contractor
options.B: The contractor, to the owner
options.C: The A/E, to the contractor
options.D: The A/E, to the owner
options.E: The owner, to the A/E
options.F: The contractor, to the A/E

questions.explanation: The owner furnishes the drawings and specifications, prepared by its A/E, to the contractor, so it is the owner that impliedly warrants their adequacy to the contractor. The A/E owes the owner the professional standard of care rather than a warranty, and it has no contract with the contractor at all.

questions.question: A court resolves an ambiguous provision by the meaning the parties themselves placed on it while performing the contract. Which rule is it applying?

options.A: Entire agreement
options.B: Construction against the drafter
options.C: Practical interpretation
options.D: Trade customs
options.E: Specific takes precedence over general
options.F: Autonomy to contract

questions.explanation: Practical interpretation reads an ambiguous provision by the practical meaning the parties themselves gave it while performing the contract. Construction against the drafter also resolves ambiguity, but it rules against whichever party wrote the provision, and trade customs look to industry practice rather than to the parties' own conduct.

questions.question: The contract documents do not establish what a provision intended. Before turning to trade customs, what may a court examine?

options.A: Trade association standards referenced in the specifications
options.B: Construction practice in other regions of the country
options.C: The owner's internal design standards and guidelines
options.D: The A/E's office master guide specification for that section
options.E: Customs and practices of the local construction trades
options.F: The A/E's interpretation issued after the dispute arose

questions.explanation: When the contract documents do not establish what a provision meant, a court may rely on the customs and practices of the trade, but if the specifications reference trade association standards, those standards may be examined first. An office master specification or the owner's unreferenced standards are not part of the contract, so they carry no such weight.

questions.question: How is the standard of care for an architect or engineer defined?

options.A: Meeting at least the minimum requirements of the building code
options.B: Doing what a prudent local A/E would do in the same situation
options.C: Matching the practices of the most qualified firms nationwide
options.D: Producing construction documents that are free of all errors
options.E: Doing what the owner-A/E agreement expressly requires of it
options.F: Guaranteeing the outcome of each of its design decisions

questions.explanation: The standard of care is doing what a reasonable and prudent A/E practicing in the same area would do under the same circumstances. Courts recognize that design professionals make mistakes and cannot guarantee outcomes, so error-free documents are not the test, and the benchmark is local professional practice, not the code minimum or the best firms nationwide.

questions.question: Which of the following are required elements for an A/E's act or omission to be negligent?

options.A: A causal connection to the other party's damage
options.B: Intent to cause the other party a loss
options.C: Failure to conform to the standard of care
options.D: Breach of an express term of the A/E's agreement
options.E: A wrong decision made in good faith
options.F: Documents that contain any error or omission

questions.explanation: Negligence requires three elements: the A/E fell short of the standard of care, the A/E's conduct is causally linked to the other party's damage, and a legally protected interest of that party was injured. Intent is not required, a wrong decision made in good faith may not be negligent, breach of an express term is a breach-of-contract claim instead, and design professionals are not expected to be error-free.

questions.question: The specifications set no submittal review time, but the architect promised five-day reviews and kept that pace until one set took 20 days. The contractor claims delay. What supports the claim?

options.A: The Spearin doctrine's implied warranty
options.B: Waiver of the submittal review provision
options.C: Contract modification by course of conduct
options.D: Construction of the terms against the drafter
options.E: Practical interpretation of an ambiguous term
options.F: Breach of an express term of the contract

questions.explanation: By consistently doing something the contract did not require, the architect created an obligation the contractor relied on to its detriment, an equitable contract modification by course of conduct. Waiver works the other way: a party that fails to enforce a provision may lose the right to enforce it. No express term was breached, because the specifications set no review time.

questions.question: A contract's general conditions were edited and no longer address a failure to act on a breach. A party then fails to act, or delays acting, on the other party's breach of a provision. What may this be considered?

options.A: A waiver of the breached provision
options.B: An implied warranty of performance
options.C: An equitable modification by course of conduct
options.D: Detrimental reliance by the breaching party
options.E: A practical interpretation of the provision
options.F: A specific term taking precedence over a general one

questions.explanation: When a party does not act on a breach, or waits too long, a court may treat that as acceptance of the breach and a waiver of the breached provision. Standard AIA, ConsensusDocs and EJCDC general conditions include clauses that bar this defense, so deleting them invites it. Modification by course of conduct is the reverse case: a party creates a duty by voluntarily doing what the contract did not require.

questions.question: Which term means performing one portion of the work before another, in a logical or predetermined order?

options.A: Multiple-prime contracting
options.B: Sequencing
options.C: Fast-track scheduling
options.D: Critical path method
options.E: Scheduling
options.F: Coordination

questions.explanation: Sequencing is performing one portion of the work before another in a logical or predetermined order, such as placing foundations before erecting the frame, and it should not be confused with scheduling. Fast-track is a scheduling technique that overlaps design and construction so construction starts before the documents are complete.

questions.question: Regardless of the delivery method, who is responsible for sequencing the construction work?

options.A: The owner
options.B: The construction manager
options.C: The architect/engineer
options.D: The contractor
options.E: Each subcontractor
options.F: The owner's representative

questions.explanation: Whatever the delivery method, the contractor is responsible for sequencing the construction work, relying on experience to put the steps in a sensible order. The contract documents may still require certain sequences or phasing for the project, but setting the overall sequence is not the owner's, the construction manager's or the A/E's job.

questions.question: In the usual classification of project delivery, how is construction manager as agent (CM-Agent) classified?

options.A: A form of multiple-prime contract
options.B: An option under construction manager at risk
options.C: A management option used with a delivery method
options.D: A project delivery method of its own
options.E: A form of owner-build delivery
options.F: A teaming arrangement with the contractor

questions.explanation: The delivery methods are design-bid-build, construction manager at risk, design-build, owner-build and integrated project delivery; CM-Agent, CM-Advisor and program management are management options an owner may add to one of them. Unlike a CMAR, a CM-Agent contracts only with the owner, holds no construction contracts, and does not guarantee construction risks.

questions.question: Which management option is typically used for multi-site or multi-building work and functions as an extension of the owner's staff?

options.A: Construction manager as advisor
options.B: Construction manager at risk
options.C: Developer-based design-build
options.D: Program management
options.E: Construction manager as agent
options.F: Single purpose entity

questions.explanation: Program managers contract only with the owner, tend to work as an extension of the owner's staff, and are typically used for multi-site or multi-building programs. A CM-Advisor only advises and cannot bind the owner, a CM-Agent acts as the owner's agent with delegated authority, and a CMAR takes on construction risk and becomes the builder.

questions.question: Under a guaranteed maximum price, the scope has not materially changed and the pricing assumptions hold, but the cost of the work exceeds the GMP. Who pays the excess?

options.A: The owner and CMAR in equal shares
options.B: The construction manager at risk
options.C: The A/E, if the documents were incomplete
options.D: The owner, from its contingency
options.E: The owner, through a change order
options.F: The trade subcontractors that ran over

questions.explanation: Once the documents are far enough along, the CMAR takes on the risk of the cost of the work and guarantees that, if the scope does not materially change and its pricing assumptions hold, the cost will not exceed the GMP, so any excess is the CMAR's. If the cost comes in under, the savings go back to the owner or are shared as the agreement provides; a change order applies only when the scope changes.

questions.question: In design-build with bridging, how complete must the bridging documents be?

options.A: No set level; conceptual design up to partial CDs
options.B: Complete construction documents ready for pricing
options.C: Design development, by definition of bridging
options.D: Schematic design only, to leave the design-builder room
options.E: Partial CDs with fully developed MEP systems
options.F: Conceptual design, with finishes left to the design-builder

questions.explanation: No standard sets how complete bridging documents must be: they may match conceptual design, schematic design or design development, or be partial construction documents. What matters is that they express the owner's desired design, with materials, products and finishes selected and the envelope's performance established, while mechanical and electrical systems need only basic device layouts.

questions.question: A design-build contract also covers buying and financing the land, furnishings and equipment, commissioning and facility management. What is it called?

options.A: A single purpose entity
options.B: A bridging contract
options.C: A turnkey contract
options.D: A program management agreement
options.E: A joint venture
options.F: Pure design-build

questions.explanation: When a design-build contract adds services beyond design and construction, such as land purchase and financing, furnishings and equipment, commissioning or facility management, it may be considered a turnkey contract: one entity delivers a facility ready for occupancy and use. Bridging is the owner's own A/E preparing a design for the design-builder to complete, and pure design-build only means one firm does both design and construction.

questions.question: Two contractors form a partnership to act as the prime contractor, sharing control, profit and risk, with each jointly and severally liable for its debts. What is this arrangement?

options.A: A joint venture
options.B: A multiple-prime contract
options.C: Constructor-based design-build
options.D: A single purpose entity
options.E: A strategic alliance teaming agreement
options.F: A single-prime contract

questions.explanation: In a joint venture, the companies join as partners to serve as the prime contractor, share control, profit and risk, and are each jointly and severally liable for the venture's debts. A strategic alliance teaming agreement instead has the other firms serve as subcontractors, not partners, and a single purpose entity is a separate company, such as an LLC, set up for one project.

questions.question: An owner signs one design-build contract with a construction company, and that company hires an A/E as its subcontractor for the design. Which design-build variation is this?

options.A: Designer-based design-build
options.B: Developer-based design-build
options.C: Constructor-based design-build
options.D: Pure design-build
options.E: Bridging design-build
options.F: Construction manager at risk

questions.explanation: Design-build variations are named for whoever holds the contract with the owner: constructor-based when a contractor holds it and subcontracts the A/E, designer-based when an A/E holds it and subcontracts the builder. Pure design-build is one integrated firm with design and construction staff in house, and developer-based design-build has a developer subcontracting both the designer and the builder.

questions.question: An architect with a prime agreement with the owner subcontracts the structural design to an engineer. How does that subcontract affect the prime agreement?

options.A: It moves the structural duties out of the prime agreement
options.B: It makes the engineer a party to the prime agreement
options.C: It amends the prime agreement for that scope
options.D: It does not modify the prime agreement
options.E: It assigns that part of the prime agreement to the engineer
options.F: It releases the architect from liability for that design

questions.explanation: A prime agreement is the original contract between the first two parties for the project's purpose. Either party may enter any number of subcontracts for related work, but none of them changes the prime agreement, so the architect still owes the owner the structural design and the engineer never becomes a party to the owner's agreement.

questions.question: In AIA A201, which defined term means the total construction, which may include construction by the owner and by separate contractors?

options.A: The Contract
options.B: The Project
options.C: The Work
options.D: The Contract Documents
options.E: Instruments of Service
options.F: The Drawings

questions.explanation: A201 defines the Project as the total construction, which may include work by the owner and by separate contractors, and of which this contract's Work may be all or part. The Work is narrower: the construction and services this contractor must provide under the Contract Documents, including its labor, materials and equipment.

questions.question: Which are behavioral principles of integrated project delivery rather than contractual ones?

options.A: Liability waivers among key participants
options.B: Fiscal transparency among key participants
options.C: Shared financial risk and reward
options.D: Mutual respect and trust
options.E: Willingness to collaborate
options.F: Collaborative decision-making

questions.explanation: IPD principles are commonly split into contractual ones that can be written into the contract, such as shared risk and reward, liability waivers, fiscal transparency and collaborative decision-making, and behavioral ones that depend on the participants' choices: mutual respect and trust, willingness to collaborate, and open communication. Collaborative decision-making is the trap, since it sounds behavioral but belongs on the contractual list.

questions.question: An early estimate prices a new hospital at a cost per bed. Which estimating method is this?

options.A: Unit price
options.B: Assemblies/systems
options.C: Order of magnitude
options.D: Unit of measure
options.E: Authorized funds
options.F: Available funds

questions.explanation: An order of magnitude estimate prices a project per unit of occupancy, such as per bed or per seat; it is the quickest and least accurate method, typically within about 20 to 25 percent. A unit of measure estimate uses cost per square foot or cubic foot instead, and a unit price estimate needs the completed construction documents.

questions.question: A note that applies only to one drawing sheet is replaced by a symbol that points to its full text elsewhere on that sheet. This is a:

options.A: Sheet keynote
options.B: General note
options.C: General discipline note
options.D: Reference symbol
options.E: Legend
options.F: Schedule

questions.explanation: Sheet keynotes, also called reference keynotes, apply only to one sheet or drawing; a symbol stands in for the note and refers to its full text elsewhere on the same sheet. General notes apply to the whole drawing set, and general discipline notes apply to every sheet of one discipline.

questions.question: General notes on the drawings should be used:

options.A: Sparingly, only for information the specifications cannot cover
options.B: Freely, for any requirement that applies to several sheets
options.C: Often, to repeat key specification requirements for emphasis
options.D: Routinely, for each consultant's administrative requirements
options.E: Only for requirements specific to one discipline's sheets
options.F: Mainly to point readers to the specifications for details

questions.explanation: General notes apply to the whole drawing set and usually sit on or near the cover sheet, so they should be kept to a minimum and used only for information the specifications cannot handle well. Repeating specification requirements in notes invites conflicts, and consultants' administrative requirements belong in Division 01, not in notes on their drawings.

questions.question: The contractor prepares a drawing to fit ductwork, piping, sprinklers, and conduit into a congested ceiling cavity. This is a:

options.A: Coordination drawing
options.B: Shop drawing
options.C: Delegated-design drawing
options.D: Record drawing
options.E: Supplemental drawing
options.F: Resource drawing
